title: Cooperating with additives: low-cost hole-transporting materials for improved stability of perovskite solar cells
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,172-184
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01356E, Paper
Paavo Mäkinen, Daniele Conelli, G. Krishnamurthy Grandhi, Gian Paolo Suranna, Paola Vivo, Roberto Grisorio
A low-cost approach for unconventional hole-transporting materials is reported. Their sustainable combination with the sole tert-butyl pyridine as an additive unprecedently stabilises the corresponding perovskite solar cells up to 400 days.
